description: This Scala source file defines the ClientDistributedCacheManager class, which manages resources for Hadoop's distributed cache in Spark's YARN deployment. It includes methods for adding resources, updating configurations, and checking file permissions.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: A case class representing a cache resource with URI, size, modification time, visibility, and resource type.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource to the distributed cache, updating local resources and cache entries.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes cache entries into SparkConf for executor access.

methods.name: getVisibility
methods.description: Determines resource visibility based on file permissions.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Checks if a resource is publicly accessible based on permissions.

methods.name: getParentURI
methods.description: Returns the parent URI of a given URI.

methods.name: ancestorsHaveExecutePermissions
methods.description: Checks if all ancestor directories have execute permissions for traversal.

methods.name: checkPermissionOfOther
methods.description: Checks if 'others' have specified permissions on a URI.

methods.name: getFileStatus
methods.description: Retrieves or caches the FileStatus of a URI.
